final_response: Done. I've replied to the customer email about the login failures and apologized for the disruption.

args.body:
Dear Customer,

Thank you for reaching out regarding the login failures your account team is experiencing. I sincerely apologize for this disruption and the impact it has had on your work.

We are actively investigating this issue and working to restore access as quickly as possible. Our technical team has been notified and is prioritizing this matter.

I will keep you updated on our progress. If you need any immediate assistance or have additional concerns, please don't hesitate to contact me directly.

Again, I apologize for the inconvenience this has caused.

Best regards,
Support Team
